prompt:
SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the TORPEDO — a sleek deep-blue underwater-style dart with swept fins, two run frames.

Design identity to keep exactly — A navy-and-teal torpedo with a hot cyan core stripe and small tail propeller; identical body in both cells, only the tail propeller and trail differ.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 2 square cells laid out as 1 ROWS OF 2 (2-column by 1-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = run frame A — propeller fins aligned, pale bubble trail upper The subject lies within aspect 1.8:1 to 4.4:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
  cell 2 = run frame B — propeller fins crossed, bubble trail lower The subject lies within aspect 1.8:1 to 4.4:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 768×256 px. Produce EXACTLY 2 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 18 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no motion blur.
- Both cells show the SAME torpedo flying right at the SAME size.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, blurry, anti-aliasing, gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell
